name: PMI Certified Professional in Managing AI (PMI-CPMAI)

entry.cost: Exam and course fees (listed on page)
entry.name: PMI Certified Professional in Managing AI (PMI-CPMAI)
entry.note: The Project Management Institute credential for running AI projects
entry.audience: Project, program and product managers leading AI initiatives

covers: Identifying data needs for AI projects
Iterating development and delivery of AI projects
Operationalizing AI responsibly and managing governance
reading.format: The certification exam has 120 questions. The 21-hour exam prep course is self-paced and uses scenario-based exercises, case studies, a downloadable workbook, multimedia content, a guided review of Exam Content Outline references, and independent study activities.
reading.summary: PMI-CPMAI is a certification for managing AI projects. It uses a tool-agnostic, results-driven approach. Holding it shows you can manage complexity, align diverse teams, and create solutions that blend technical excellence with strategic impact.
reading.audience: The page says it is for project managers, technologists, data experts, and consultants. It suits people already delivering AI initiatives or those who want to start.
reading.validity: To maintain certification, PMI-CPMAI holders must earn 30 professional development units (PDUs) every 3 years.
